segments.he:
א.

אֵין כֹּחַ הַקְּלָלָה חָל עַל מְיֻחָס.
segments.en: The force of a curse does not effect, one with respected lineage.

segments.he:
ב.

אֲפִלּוּ אִשָּׁה צַדֶּקֶת כְּשֶׁהִיא אֵינָהּ מְיֻחֶסֶת, עַל-יְדֵי-זֶה מוֹלֶדֶת בָּנִים שֶׁאֵינָם מְהֻגָּנִים.
segments.en: Even a righteous woman, if she does not have respected lineage, through this she will have children who are not upright.

segments.he:
ג.

קָשֶׁה לִפְנֵי הַקָּדוֹשׁ-בָּרוּךְ-הוּא לְהַעֲבִיר וּלְבַטֵּל גְּדוֹלֵי הַיִּחוּס.
segments.en:
The force of a curse does not effect, one with respected lineage.

Even a righteous woman, if she does not have respected lineage, through this she will have children who are not upright.

It is difficult for the Holy One Blessed be He to cast away and annul those with respected lineage.
